title: I001: Add cross-compiled binary release workflow
summary: Adds `.github/workflows/release.yml` triggered on `v*` tag push that cross-compiles `plexd` for linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 via build matrix, generates SHA-256 checksums, and creates a GitHub Release via `softprops/action-gh-release`. All actions are SHA-pinned (checkout/setup-go match ci.yml). Includes 17 shell tests in `test_release_workflow.sh` and 9 Go tests in `internal/cicheck/release_workflow_test.go`. Reference docs at `docs/reference/backend/release-workflow.md` follow ci-workflow.md format.

tests_checklist.item: Shell tests exist and all 17 pass
Go tests exist and all 9 pass
Trigger config (v* tag push only) tested
Combined checksums.sha256 file NOT tested (missing from tests)

code_quality_checklist.item: Workflow YAML is clean and minimal (65 lines)
Follows ci.yml patterns (runner, Go version, SHA pins)
Shell test script follows test_dockerfile.sh structure
Go tests use structured YAML parsing (not string grep)
No dead code or commented-out code

security_checklist.item: Permissions block declares only contents: write
All 5 actions pinned to full 40-char SHA
checkout and setup-go SHAs match ci.yml exactly
No path traversal or injection vectors

architecture_checklist.item: Two-job design (build matrix + release) is appropriate
Cross-compilation via GOOS/GOARCH (no native runners needed)
Solution is as simple as possible

fail_fast_checklist.item: Build job failure prevents release job (needs: build)
Go tests use t.Fatal for critical setup failures
Shell tests exit 1 on any failure

defensive_checklist.item: Timeout-minutes set on both jobs (15 and 10)
retention-days: 1 on upload-artifact prevents storage bloat

architecture_findings.description: Implementation uses softprops/action-gh-release instead of gh release create as specified in plan task 1.3. This adds a third-party action dependency but is SHA-pinned and well-maintained. Acceptable alternative.
architecture_findings.fix: No fix required — acceptable deviation. The action provides more robust release creation than raw CLI.

issues_found.description: Missing combined checksums.sha256 file. Plan task 1.3 requires: 'generate checksums.sha256 via sha256sum plexd-linux-* > checksums.sha256'. The implementation generates per-binary .sha256 files (plexd-linux-amd64.sha256, plexd-linux-arm64.sha256) instead of a single combined checksums.sha256. install.sh:156 downloads checksums.sha256 by that exact name and greps for the binary name (line 90). The per-binary format is incompatible.
issues_found.fix: In the release job, after downloading artifacts, add a step to concatenate per-binary checksums: 'cat plexd-linux-*.sha256 > checksums.sha256'. Add checksums.sha256 to the files list in softprops/action-gh-release. The per-binary .sha256 files can optionally be kept as additional assets or removed.

issues_found.description: Plan task 1.3 specifies uploading 3 artifacts (plexd-linux-amd64, plexd-linux-arm64, checksums.sha256). The implementation uploads 4 artifacts (two binaries + two per-binary .sha256 files) but NOT the combined checksums.sha256 required by the plan and install.sh.
issues_found.fix: Same as C2-1: generate combined checksums.sha256 in release job and include it in release assets.

issues_found.description: Neither shell tests nor Go tests verify that a combined checksums.sha256 file would be produced. Shell test test_checksum_generation only checks for sha256sum command presence, not the output filename convention. Go test TestReleaseWorkflow_ReleaseSteps checks for per-binary .sha256 files but not for combined checksums.sha256.
issues_found.fix: After fixing the workflow, add test assertions verifying: (1) release job has a step that produces checksums.sha256, (2) checksums.sha256 is listed in release files.

issues_found.description: docs/reference/backend/release-workflow.md documents per-binary .sha256 files (lines 85-89, 95-101) which is consistent with the current (incorrect) implementation but inconsistent with the plan spec. After fixing the workflow, docs must be updated to reflect the combined checksums.sha256.
issues_found.fix: After fixing the workflow, update the Artifact Naming and Checksum Format sections to document the combined checksums.sha256 file alongside per-binary files (if kept).

suggested_improvements: Consider adding darwin/amd64 and darwin/arm64 to the build matrix in a future iteration if macOS support is desired
Consider adding a workflow_dispatch trigger for manual release creation during testing
next_steps: Fix release job: add step to generate combined checksums.sha256 from per-binary .sha256 files
Add checksums.sha256 to softprops/action-gh-release files list
Update shell test and Go test to verify combined checksums.sha256 is produced and uploaded
Update release-workflow.md to document combined checksums.sha256 format
